basis: Neurodevelopmental disorder with developmental delay in 16/16; hypotonia and feeding difficulty do not establish separate muscle or gastrointestinal damage.
Brain, caudal skeletal and severe eye malformations define disease; renal insufficiency 30-79%. Cleft palate, nasal and cerebral vascular anomalies omitted under cap.
Superficial dermal fibrous proliferation of digits; skin nodules obligatory. No evidence of common deeper locomotor involvement.
Isolated spermatogenic failure with abnormal sperm flagella and infertility; reproductive function has no axis.
Renal tubular bicarbonate wasting defines an acid-base disorder. Rickets and osteomalacia are reported without frequencies sufficient to establish common bone damage.
Vertebral defects and tracheoesophageal malformations predominate; renal defects are defining criteria. Cardiac defects and developmental delay (3/9) omitted under cap.
Skeletal dysplasia with obligatory limb shortening and frequent vertebral and joint abnormalities; short stature reflects skeletal disease.
Congenital retinal signaling dysfunction causes stationary night blindness and reduced visual acuity; no extraocular disease established.
Alveolar proteinosis causes respiratory failure; hypogammaglobulinemia defines immunodeficiency. Leukocytosis and splenomegaly alone do not establish additional organ damage.
Severe intellectual disability, motor regression and progressive disabling joint contractures define the syndrome; oral morphology alone does not establish gut damage.
Intrinsic neutrophil granule and bactericidal defects define a blood-cell immunodeficiency. Recurrent infections do not establish common lasting lung or ear damage.
Autoimmune lymphoproliferative disorder defined by abnormal lymphocyte proliferation with lymphadenopathy and/or splenomegaly; no other common organ damage established.
PRCD-associated rod-cone retinal degeneration; retinal vascular attenuation and optic disc pallor remain within the ocular axis.
Immunoglobulin-isotype deficiency; recurrent infections and separately diagnosed asthma do not establish direct chronic lung damage. Bronchiectasis occurs in only 5-29%.
Inherited cardiac conduction disease with atrial arrhythmias and possible cardiomyopathy; all defining pathology is cardiovascular.
Inherited generalized epilepsy is defined by abnormal cerebral electrical function; no common extra-neurologic damage across the umbrella.
Promyelocytic marrow malignancy with cytopenias and coagulopathy. Bruising and mucosal bleeding do not establish separate organ damage; infections are secondary diseases.
Pure hereditary spastic paraplegia primarily degenerates corticospinal pathways; spasticity and weakness do not establish intrinsic skeletal muscle disease.
Isolated microphthalmia/nanophthalmos with hypermetropia and possible ocular hypertension; disease is confined to the eye.
Anatomical umbrella for middle-ear disease; infection or immune mechanisms do not apply to every subtype.
Distal tubular acidification failure and metabolic acidosis with defining progressive sensorineural hearing loss; nephrocalcinosis remains renal.
Ichthyosis, deafness and immune-mediated atopy define syndrome; asthma and chronic rhinitis affect 2/2. Hyperthyroidism in 1/2 is a separate diagnosis.
Duct-centered follicular inflammation directly affects bile ducts and exocrine pancreatic ducts. An autoimmune mechanism is not established by lymphoid histology alone.
Familial carcinoma arising in ovarian epithelium; reproductive tumour origin has no axis, and endocrine dysfunction is not defining.
Umbrella of Huntington disease and related inherited neurodegenerative disorders; common defining damage is cerebral.
